# Public policies / 公开政策页面

- Operator / 经营者署名: 不专业商店 · XNotPro
- Contact / 联系方式: support@xnotpro.site
- Public URLs / 公开地址: https://xnotpro.site/privacy and https://xnotpro.site/terms
- Effective / 生效日期: 2026-11-26

Confirmed scope: digital products, gift cards, cloud-storage memberships and AI
service entitlements. AI access is delivered; this store does not accept prompts
or file uploads. Google sign-in uses openid/email/profile. No ads are displayed;
Google Analytics is planned. This change adds no analytics scripts.

已确认业务为虚拟商品、礼品卡、网盘会员及 AI 使用权益；本站不接收 AI 提示词或文件。
Google 登录仅使用基本身份与邮箱权限。不投放广告，Google Analytics 为计划接入，
本变更不安装统计脚本。

Policy text is maintained in messages/en-US.json and messages/zh-CN.json using
the legal_ prefix. Both routes use the public layout and require no sign-in.
The shared public footer links to both pages. Recheck the policies when adding
analytics, uploads, providers or changing refund practices; do not claim a
consent control exists before implementing it.

政策正文使用 Paraglide 双语消息；两个页面均公开访问，共享商城页脚入口。
后续接入统计、上传、服务商或调整退款规则时，应同步核对正文与实际行为。

Refunds distinguish undisclosed/invalid/wrong delivery from change-of-mind
requests after a valid code is revealed or an entitlement activated. Statutory
consumer rights remain preserved; no arbitrary claim deadline is introduced.
